name: EverestIMS Technologies
lm_rationale: Oneview Corporate Advisors — 2 SME IPOs in 2026 (₹117.51 Cr), 2 of 2 listed positive (100%), +25.53% avg listing gain (chittorgarh 2026 SME tracker); small sample.
net_proceeds: Of the ₹39.05 Cr fresh issue, ₹24.00 Cr goes to working capital and ₹5.66 Cr to IT hardware (laptops, servers, storage, switches) for an AI Innovation and Experience Laboratory, with the balance for general corporate purposes. The ₹9.41 Cr OFS goes to 13 selling shareholders (8 promoters, 4 employees, 1 public).
key_risks: Top ten customers supplied 88.77% of FY26 revenue from operations, and trade receivables of ₹51.96 Cr at 31 Mar 2026 were close to 80% of that year's ₹65.12 Cr revenue from operations.
market_moat: Owns the 'Infraon Infinity' platform covering ITSM, ITIM, NCCM, AIOps, ITAM and OSS, sold both as SaaS and on-premise, with direct sales plus a US subsidiary (Infraon Corp) and channel partners.
management: Promoters Satish Kumar Vijayaragavan, Sudhakar Aruchamy, Arun Prasath Ramadoss, Ramesh Pratap Tiwari, Deepak Kumar Shenbagarajan, Srikanth Audina, Ganesh Kumar Nagaiah and Deepak Gupta; 80.38% pre-issue promoter holding drops to 58.98% post-issue.
prose_business: Bengaluru software company (incorporated 2017) selling IT operations and service management software under the Infraon brand, both as SaaS and as on-premise installs. Of FY26 revenue from operations of ₹65.12 Cr, domestic software product sales were ₹46.76 Cr, domestic services ₹9.18 Cr, a new domestic hardware line ₹5.25 Cr and exports ₹3.93 Cr.
highlight_dev: ₹5.66 Cr of the fresh issue funds an AI Innovation and Experience Laboratory inside its existing Bengaluru premises (95 laptops plus servers, storage and switches), to be deployed in FY27.
sector_outlook: The RHP's industry section puts India's IT operations and service management market at US$ 1,011.55 million in 2023, projected to reach US$ 2,665.58 million by 2031 (12.9% CAGR).
peer_sentence: At 14.00x post-issue P/E, EverestIMS is priced below the RHP's only listed peer, Newgen Software Technologies (23.45x); the RHP itself says the peer is not strictly comparable given the size gap.
verdict_reason: debt-free, 35.41% EBITDA margin, 14.00x post P/E vs peer 23.45x
why: EverestIMS is debt-free with a 35.41% EBITDA margin and a 21.69% RoNW, but FY26 PAT slipped 6.66% to ₹13.14 Cr even as total income grew 14.08%. At ₹85 it trades at 14.00x post-issue EPS and 2.39x FY26 NAV, below Newgen's 23.45x in the RHP peer table. About 80% of the issue is fresh money going to working capital and an AI lab; the ₹9.41 Cr OFS is modest. Oneview's two 2026 SME listings both opened positive (+25.53% avg). The main risks are concentration (top ten customers at 88.77% of revenue) and ₹51.96 Cr of receivables against ₹65.12 Cr revenue.
suggestion: Apply for medium term; watch receivables and customer concentration, listing gain uncertain until GMP appears.
